main.description: Run an XRPC query and hydrate its response with a data sidecar: typed payloads for every did / at-uri / strong-ref found in the response.

xrpc.description: NSID of the inner query to run, e.g. org.tangled.repo.listRepos.

params.description: Parameters for the inner query, exactly as it declares them.

enrich.description: Payloads to compute for each found reference.

viewer.description: DID whose own relation to each reference is looked up for viewer payloads and views. Required when any descriptor requests a viewer payload.

data.description: Reference (did or at-uri) -> link source -> payload type nsid -> payload. References no descriptor applies to are absent.

errors.name: UnknownQuery
errors.description: The xrpc parameter does not name a query this server can execute

errors.name: InvalidTargetPath
errors.description: A targets entry is not a valid record path

errors.name: InvalidLinkDescriptor
errors.description: An enrich entry names an unknown payload type, collection, or path

linkDescriptor.description: One sidecar payload, computed from the records at a link source whose reference equals the found reference.

source.description: Collection whose records are linked, a colon, then an index-backed path (subject or .repo), or . for the record the reference names, which hydrates into that collection's view.

type.description: NSID of the payload type to produce, which also defines the payload's shape. Results land at data[ref][source][type].

targets.description: Record paths into the inner response selecting references for this payload. A path can end in an envelope: path:.repo for a ref's author, path:.rkey for the did its rkey names, path:. for the ref itself. All references are considered when omitted.

labels.description: Moderation labels the configured labeler applied. Only !hide and !warn are served, takedowns leave subjects out instead. Use collection:. for labels on the record, collection:.repo for labels on its author's account. Absent when there are none.
